headline: US Banks Tighten Controls on AI Agents to Prevent Them from Running Out of Control
summary: US banks are strengthening controls over AI agents to prevent them from acting uncontrolled, following incidents at technology companies.
why: Large banks are major adopters of AI, and their risk controls shape how the technology is deployed across finance.
original_headline: Bancos estadounidenses refuerzan los controles sobre los agentes de IA para evitar que se descontrolen
